description: One band covers the whole day: the owner removed the curfew mode and confirmed every remaining mode is usable at any time, so there is no longer a day/night split. The order is the owner's Sydney priority picture (sydney-mode-priority-order.png), as amended by the owner 29-10-2026 to put 34AD and 16AD at the same priority as 25A16D: 1 SODPROPS; 2 modes 07A16D, 34AD25, 34A25D, 25A16D, 34AD, 16AD (equal); 3 modes 07AD, 25AD (equal). The picture gives an order only, so the penalties are placeholders on the design example scale (0, 2, 12) for the owner to confirm; lower is preferred, equal numbers are equal priority. Replace with the current LTOP when supplied.
